Procurement asked that invoices be issued to our central finance team (Solaryn Finance, EIN: 12-3456789) rather than the BU contact we used previously. They also want the new PO to list the legal payor as "Solaryn Inc. (Parent)" and route invoices to payments@solaryn.com.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Alex — thanks for the heads up and the docs. Congrats on the expansion!

Quick notes / next steps from our side:
- We can accept Solaryn Inc. as the payor, but Net30 requires our finance/legal sign-off for the renewal amendment. By default renewals are Net45 unless approved.
- To progress quickly, please confirm the exact legal entity name (as it should appear on the invoice) and the billing contact (name, email, phone).
- Please send the signed PO back to accounts-payable@redwood.ai. We’ll issue an acknowledgement once internal approvals are complete.
- I’ve looped in Ben (billing ops) to validate routing and Marissa (CS) to update invoicing for the capacity add. Karthik — FYI on timeline/contract amendment.

I attached our PO acknowledgement template to speed things up. If procurement needs a DocuSign path, we can provide that as well.

Thanks,
